fluff.overview: The Combine's martial traditions extend beyond the BattleMech cockpit, and the Dictum Honorium demands that all citizens contribute their talents to the defense of House Kurita. Infantry soldiers of the DCMS embody that expectation on garrison worlds across the realm. Foot infantry are the cheapest troops the DCMS can field, and the Combine fields them in enormous numbers. Every military district maintains garrison formations whose sole purpose is holding ground that BattleMech regiments cannot occupy permanently. Slow and vulnerable in open terrain, these soldiers prove their worth through discipline and endurance, standing post on worlds across the Combine because the Dragon demands nothing less. Armed with infantry-scale gauss rifles that use magnetic acceleration to hurl projectiles at extreme velocities. The longest-ranged and hardest-hitting personal ballistic weapon available to conventional soldiers, though the weapons are expensive and maintenance-intensive enough that most commands reserve them for their best marksmen.
